target.description: Id of one {group} (its first {node} is used) or of one {node}

owner.description: INUBIT user or user group owning the workflows; default: inventory.owner of the {node}; not with `metadata`

content.description: `workflows` (default): one archive per technical workflow of `diagramGroup`; `ownerWithoutGroups`: one archive of the owner's technical workflows without the diagram groups `excludeGroups`; `metadata`: one archive of the metadata registry

diagramGroup.description: The diagram group whose technical workflows are archived; required for and only allowed with `workflows`

workflows.description: Only these workflows (case-sensitive names); default: all technical workflows of the diagram group, at most 50; only with `workflows`

excludeGroups.description: The diagram groups left out; required for and only allowed with `ownerWithoutGroups`

metadataNames.description: Only these metadata registry entries (metadata names, not workflow names; INUBIT accepts names that do not exist); default: the whole registry; only with `metadata`

targetFolder.description: Absolute path of the local folder for the archives; created owner-only if missing

acknowledgeClearTextSecrets.description: Must be true for `workflows` and `ownerWithoutGroups`: the archives contain passwords, keys and other secrets in clear text

reason.description: Why the archives are exported; stored in the audit log
